values.meaning: Observed desktop appearance values; unobserved or unimplemented values are null.

color_scheme.meaning: The observed color preference; only prefer-dark maps to dark.

cursor_theme.meaning: The observed cursor theme, preferring a Sway override when available.

cursor_size.meaning: The observed cursor size from the active override or desktop setting.

font_size.meaning: The numeric suffix of the observed interface font, if present.

options.meaning: Available icon_theme and cursor_theme choices as arrays of {value, label} strings; unavailable or empty lists are omitted.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Present on refusal. Besides the fixed intake messages, the reader reports missing envelope kernel keys: <comma-separated keys> and can return a raw ValueError diagnostic.
